matching: greedy disjoint nearest pairs in fixed scaled control space; cross source, same component and reco-pz bin, exact status; no truth/outcome matching
strong_signal: wave valid; no fit failure/overflow/threshold failure; raw_peak>=5*baseline_rms>0; finite positive width and finite localtime
pair_metric: sum squared normalized control differences; each difference <= tolerance; greedy sorted distance then identity; no event reuse within channel
relative_time: only uncorrected Timing0-1 and Timing2-3 diagnostics; physically corrected time remains unavailable
claims: descriptive conditional variation at finite tolerance; not strict conditional independence, calibrated physical timing, or energy information gain
uncertainty: no inferential p-values; source/component/pz support and spread retained; insufficient pairs remain unmeasured
